title: Federated Identity Pattern
description: OAuth2/OIDC authorization-code flow in Python (FastAPI + PyJWKClient), JavaScript (express-openid-connect), and Java (Spring Security), with real JWKS signature validation and IdP-propagated logout.
description_es: Flujo OAuth2/OIDC authorization-code en Python (FastAPI + PyJWKClient), JavaScript (express-openid-connect) y Java (Spring Security), con validación de firma JWKS real y logout propagado al IdP.
